ES.visaType: Type D Long-Stay Study Visa (Visado Nacional de Larga Duración)
ES.duration: Required for stays >90 days (full semester). Short-stay Schengen visa for visits <90 days.
requiredDocuments: Valid passport (min. 1 year validity beyond intended stay)
Completed national visa application form
2 recent passport photographs (35×45mm, white background)
University admission letter (Carta de Admisión from URJC)
Proof of sufficient funds (Erasmus grant letter + bank statements)
Health insurance valid in Spain (min. €30,000 coverage)
Proof of accommodation in Spain (rental contract or residence letter)
Criminal background check (apostilled in your country)
Medical certificate
Visa fee payment receipt (~€80)
ES.notes: Apply at the Spanish embassy/consulate in your home country at least 8 weeks before travel. Appointments must be in person. After arriving in Spain, apply for the TIE (Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero) at the Oficina de Extranjería within 30 days of arrival.

GB.visaType: Student Visa (UK Visas and Immigration — Student route)
GB.duration: Course length + additional time. For ~5 month semester, Standard Visitor may apply.
requiredDocuments: Valid passport
Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from Bangor University
Online UK visa application at gov.uk
Biometric enrolment at UK Visa Application Centre in your country
Bank statements showing funds for full stay
Proof of English language proficiency (IELTS Academic 5.5+ or equivalent)
Tuberculosis (TB) test results (if from a listed country — check gov.uk)
Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) payment — £776/year (grants NHS access)
Visa fee: £490
GB.notes: Apply for your UK Student Visa at least 6–8 weeks before the course start date. If your semester is under 6 months, confirm with Bangor University whether a Standard Visitor Visa (£115, no CAS needed) is sufficient. Your BRP (Biometric Residence Permit) will be issued in the UK — collect it from the designated Post Office within 10 days of arrival.

MX.visaType: Visa de Visitante (Visitor Visa — no work permit)
MX.duration: Up to 180 days — sufficient for the 6-week summer school
requiredDocuments: Valid passport (6+ months validity beyond travel dates)
Completed Mexican visa application form
Recent passport photograph
Proof of enrollment/invitation letter from UATx
Bank statements proving sufficient funds (~USD 1,500 minimum)
Round-trip flight reservation or itinerary
Proof of accommodation in Tlaxcala
Visa fee (~USD 36)
MX.notes: Apply at the Mexican embassy or consulate serving your home country. Processing is usually 2–4 weeks. The summer school (6–8 weeks) is well within the 180-day visa validity. Upon arrival you receive an FMM card — keep it safe and return it when you leave Mexico.

PT.visaType: Visto de Residência para Estudo (Type D Study Visa)
PT.duration: Valid for entry; converted to Autorização de Residência (AR) within 4 months of arrival
requiredDocuments: Valid passport (min. 3 months beyond course end date)
Completed Type D visa application form (via VFS Global or Portuguese embassy)
2 recent passport photographs
University enrollment/acceptance letter from Portuguese partner institution
Proof of accommodation in Portugal (rental contract or university housing letter)
Proof of financial means — bank statements or Erasmus grant letter
Health insurance valid in Portugal (private policy for non-EU)
Criminal record certificate from your home country (apostilled)
Visa fee (~€90)
PT.notes: Apply at the Portuguese embassy or consulate in your home country before travelling. After arrival in Portugal, register with AIMA (Agência para a Integração, Migrações e Asilo) within 4 months to obtain your Autorização de Residência card. Get your NIF (Número de Identificação Fiscal) in your first week — required for renting accommodation and opening a bank account.

ES.visaType: Type D Long-Stay Study Visa (Visado Nacional de Larga Duración)
ES.duration: Required for stays >90 days (full semester). Short-stay Schengen visa for visits <90 days.
requiredDocuments: Valid passport (min. 1 year validity beyond intended stay)
Completed national visa application form
2 recent passport photographs (35×45mm, white background)
University admission letter (Carta de Admisión from URJC)
Proof of sufficient funds (Erasmus grant letter + bank statements)
Health insurance valid in Spain (min. €30,000 coverage)
Proof of accommodation in Spain (rental contract or residence letter)
Criminal background check (apostilled in your country)
Medical certificate
Visa fee payment receipt (~€80)
ES.notes: Apply at the Spanish embassy/consulate in your home country at least 8 weeks before travel. Appointments must be in person. After arriving in Spain, apply for the TIE (Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero) at the Oficina de Extranjería within 30 days of arrival.

GB.visaType: Student Visa (UK Visas and Immigration — Student route)
GB.duration: Course length + additional time. For ~5 month semester, Standard Visitor may apply.
requiredDocuments: Valid passport
Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from Bangor University
Online UK visa application at gov.uk
Biometric enrolment at UK Visa Application Centre in your country
Bank statements showing funds for full stay
Proof of English language proficiency (IELTS Academic 5.5+ or equivalent)
Tuberculosis (TB) test results (if from a listed country — check gov.uk)
Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) payment — £776/year (grants NHS access)
Visa fee: £490
GB.notes: Apply for your UK Student Visa at least 6–8 weeks before the course start date. If your semester is under 6 months, confirm with Bangor University whether a Standard Visitor Visa (£115, no CAS needed) is sufficient. Your BRP (Biometric Residence Permit) will be issued in the UK — collect it from the designated Post Office within 10 days of arrival.

MX.visaType: Visa de Visitante (Visitor Visa — no work permit)
MX.duration: Up to 180 days — sufficient for the 6-week summer school
requiredDocuments: Valid passport (6+ months validity beyond travel dates)
Completed Mexican visa application form
Recent passport photograph
Proof of enrollment/invitation letter from UATx
Bank statements proving sufficient funds (~USD 1,500 minimum)
Round-trip flight reservation or itinerary
Proof of accommodation in Tlaxcala
Visa fee (~USD 36)
MX.notes: Apply at the Mexican embassy or consulate serving your home country. Processing is usually 2–4 weeks. The summer school (6–8 weeks) is well within the 180-day visa validity. Upon arrival you receive an FMM card — keep it safe and return it when you leave Mexico.

PT.visaType: Visto de Residência para Estudo (Type D Study Visa)

requiredDocuments: Valid passport (min. 3 months beyond course end date)

2 recent passport photographs
University enrollment/acceptance letter from Portuguese partner institution
Proof of accommodation in Portugal (rental contract or university housing letter)
Proof of financial means — bank statements or Erasmus grant letter
Health insurance valid in Portugal (private policy for non-EU)
Criminal record certificate from your home country (apostilled)
Visa fee (~€90)
PT.notes: Apply at the Portuguese embassy or consulate in your home country before travelling. After arrival in Portugal, register with AIMA (Agência para a Integração, Migrações e Asilo) within 4 months to obtain your Autorização de Residência card. Get your NIF (Número de Identificação Fiscal) in your first week — required for renting accommodation and opening a bank account.
